MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Pond? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Pond.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Pond.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Pond.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Pond.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of ? (1 mark)

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems? (1 mark)
